name: @hrizzup/perps
description: The Bitcoin perp's back end (PLAN.md step 3.4a): each trade, price and funding one step (one database transaction under the perp's lock, running the perp's maths from @hrizzup/market-engine on the book as it stands, with the database's time passed in, rounded once into exact play money); the calls for everyone (its price and details, opening, closing and positions), the console's for admins (the off switch, the settings and the rule-change log; a check run's own test perps) and the scheduled jobs (every 5 seconds the next price and the liquidation check, every hour the funding). Server only.
